clauses.why: Placing the component on App, Home, Record pages and the utility bar goes beyond one working chat surface.
Titles exist only to serve a multi-conversation list, which the request does not call for.
Per-message timestamps are a convenience; the bot works without them.
A notice about context truncation is an added feature; the chat works without it.
Marking truncated replies is an added display feature not required for a working bot.
A custom Log object written on failures is an operator observability feature the request does not ask for.
Defines fields of the Log object, which is itself beyond the request.
An admin Logs tab with filtering is an observability feature beyond a Grok bot.
Recording token usage per reply for spend reports is not needed for the bot to work.
Forbidding edit or delete of single messages is a restriction the request's purpose does not call for.
A browsable list of past conversations is history management beyond a working chat bot.
List ordering by activity arises only from the conversation list the spec added.
Paging a conversation list arises only from the list the spec introduced.
User deletion of stored conversations, with confirmation and hard delete, is an added capability.
Arises only from the conversation-deletion feature the spec introduced.
An administrator on/off switch is an added control; permission sets already stop use.
A scheduled nightly retention purge is an added maintenance capability the request does not call for.
Batching the purge arises only from the purge job the spec introduced.
Constrains all future versions to additive schema changes; not needed to deliver the bot.
Rollback to earlier commits is a release-management duty beyond the request.
A test suite is not required in a development org; it serves shipping beyond the request.
Per-category test coverage is a testing duty the request does not call for.
75% coverage is required only for production; the clause itself says a development org does not enforce it.
Moving to sandbox or production orgs is beyond a bot in a development org.
Keyboard operation and screen-reader announcements are added accessibility work the request does not ask for.
Arises only from conversation deletion and purge, both of which the spec introduced.
Arises only from the scheduled purge job the spec introduced.
Purge-failure recovery arises only from the purge job the spec introduced.
